proof_summary: Take \(N=2^{13}3^6 5\,7^6 13^4 17^2=28996592704045424640\); multiplicativity of \(\sigma\) gives \(\sigma(N)=2\cdot3^2\cdot29\cdot43\cdot127\cdot307\cdot1093\cdot4733\cdot30941\). Hence multiplying \((p-1)^e\) over this prime factorization yields \(N\), so \(N\) is a positive fixed point absent from the proposed list.
